Both gates that use findStatusProse assert only that their corpus is CLEAN — an empty-set assertion proves nothing about the detector itself, so a typo in a marker regex or a normalizeProse regression would turn both gates green while scanning nothing (the client_libs_tripwire failure mode this repo names). These vectors are the positive half: MUST_FIRE holds prose the detector is REQUIRED to catch, MUST_STAY_CLEAN holds the rule wording it is REQUIRED to leave alone.
